blocks.text:
To: Tiffany Munoz
Cc: Richard Henderson

Richard Henderson has the searching moving, and his point about the priority list is the right one, since a short read on which rights matter most to the deal lets us put our attention where the transaction actually turns. We will scope the searches to those first and keep the broader landscape running behind them.

On timing for {{fact:f:E-2025-001.client}}, once your document set is in we move from setup to substance quickly, and you will have our first read on the material agreements within a couple of weeks of a complete set. Nothing reaches you as a conclusion until the searching behind it is done.
If it is easier on your side, we can take the Price-Henson documents in batches as you pull them together, and we will start on whatever arrives first. Send them my way whenever they are ready.
